findings.observed: All four customers rejected changing red shoes to the white size-10 variant used by the reference; agent transferred without modifying the order.
findings.reference_vs_request: Scenario explicitly requests size changes but does not explicitly authorize a color change; original shoes are red, reference size-10 shoes are white. Customer simulation preserved other original attributes.
findings.interpretation: Valid reference tool replay does not prove the interactive customer will accept the reference. Zero reward here is not evidence of broken tool execution.

findings.observed: Both exchange write targets executed successfully without tool errors. Exact replay differs from reference only in exchange_payment_method_id on the two target orders: gift card versus credit card. Customer confirmed the gift-card proposal.
findings.policy: Gift-card price-difference payment/refund is permitted by original policy and tool.
findings.interpretation: Original strict DB scorer returns 0; do not relabel or change it in this experiment. It does not imply exchanges were never requested.

findings.observed: Generated two opening tool_call tags with one closing tag; strict parser rejected it and one temperature-0 retry recovered a single action.
findings.interpretation: One observed protocol retry, not the primary cause of the four zero scores.

findings.observed: Some assistant explanations gave incorrect size-change differences. From actual returned prices the correct net increase is (159.92-149.48)+(154.75-158.67)=6.52. Seed45 used calculate and gave 6.52.
findings.interpretation: Additional model weakness outside the current deterministic reward scope; no reward adjustment made.

findings.observed: Assistant claimed Visa details would need to be provided again, despite an existing on-file payment method being available.
findings.interpretation: Business success does not certify every natural-language claim.

findings.observed: All four initially called find_user_id_by_name_zip with zip=20001 even though the customer had only provided name, not the zip. All received User not found, then recovered via the known email.
findings.interpretation: Real model parameter guessing; final-success reward does not separately penalize this recoverable query error.

findings.observed: Agent proposed and customer confirmed Suite 200, but modify_pending_order_address for #W1221555 sent Suite 001. Other writes used Suite 200. The valid schema allowed the wrong address; no correction occurred before termination.
findings.interpretation: Genuine model execution error, correctly assigned original zero reward; distinct from reference ambiguity.

infrastructure_attempt.error: Balance GET ConnectionError before next customer POST
infrastructure_attempt.treatment: Preserved as unscored infrastructure failure; retry from episode start in recovery_01 using same opening and seed; completed seeds42/43 untouched.
